items.q: Which past bubble does Eisman compare AI to?
items.a: The **dot-com bubble**: the **same sentences**, overinvestment, most early companies bust, **second-generation winners**.

items.q: How much of the S&P 500 is exposed to AI?
items.a: Infotech is about **40%** (prior record ~25%) and AI-linked sectors about **65%**.

items.q: What happens if the big AI labs fail?
items.a: AI capex is **over half of GDP growth**, so the US would be in **recession the next day**.
Buy the **S&P 500 index**, **keep adding** every few months, and **don't look**.

items.q: Do you need to beat the market?
items.a: No: people **lose too much money looking for an edge**; matching the market is enough.

items.q: Why does Eisman never buy crypto?
items.a: It **moves opposite to its own hedge thesis**, rising and falling with Nvidia, so it's **speculation on speculation**.

items.q: What management signal makes Eisman run?
items.a: **Founders dumping stock**: CoreWeave's founders sold **over $3B** of a ~$24B company.

items.q: Which single stock would he hold?
items.a: A **natural duopoly** like **Visa or Moody's**, which is **near impossible to recreate**.
No: owning often **costs more**, so **renting and investing the difference** can build a bigger nest egg.
